title: The Negotiation
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, tensions escalate when Roy attacks Jim, but Dwight intervenes with pepper spray, leading to Roy's firing. Meanwhile, Darryl leverages the incident to request a raise, prompting a series of negotiations involving Michael, Jan, and Darryl, with Michael employing unconventional tactics and wearing a woman's suit. Personal relationships and conflicts intertwine, including Kelly and Ryan's argument and Angela and Dwight's budding connection. The episode ends with several negotiations unresolved and Andy's return to the office marked by another pepper spray incident.
